text:
Avery (CEO): Executive weekly  quick pulse: Optimize beta live for early customers, small incident on Wed (resolved), new vendor access controls, and hiring ramp for data infra. High level bullets below.

Mira (VP Product): Optimize beta: first three pilots onboarded. Initial feedback: 30% less token spend for chat workloads when using suggested batching + cache settings. We're collecting standard evals and will publish a short runbook for sales.

Sam (VP Research): Tech note: Optimize heuristics are still conservative by default. We shipped an opt-in aggressive mode for pilots; results vary by prompt shape. Please tag any failures with #eng-ml so we can iterate.

Priya (Head of Customer Success): CS update: pilots are enthusiastic but flagged one integration quirk with webhooks timing out. Support ticket created; priority fix ETA 48h. Also prepping NPS check-ins for Optimize pilot cohort next week.

Jon (VP Eng): Incident summary (Wed 03:20 UTC)  brief: autoscaler misfired during a burst which briefly exceeded capacity knob, causing 5-10m of 429s for some Hosted customers. Rolling restart and manual override mitigated within 12m. Root cause: kube-probe misclassification + a race in scale-down. Postmortem draft in #incidents and PR link: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/181050.

incident-bot: incident 2026-03-18-01 created by @Jon  severity: S3  status: resolved  postmortem: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/181050

Avery (CEO): Thanks for the quick work. Action items from the incident: 1) backstop policy for autoscaler (Jon), 2) improved alerting for 5xx spike (eng-sre), 3) customer communication template (Priya). Please confirm owners.

Jon (VP Eng): Confirmed  I'll ship autoscale backstop and the probe fix by EOD tomorrow.

Priya (Head of Customer Success): I'll own the customer comms and coordinate with marketing on a brief note.

Mira (VP Product): I'll add a datastorelevel metric to the Optimize dashboard so pilots can see token-savings live.

Avery (CEO): Policy update (short): 1) Vendor access baseline now requires MFA + yearly security attestation; 2) Export control checklist added for certain pre-release model weights. Full policy pages: https://confluence.redwood/security/vendor-access and https://confluence.redwood/compliance/export-controls. Review window: 72h.

Sam (VP Research): Heads up  export checklist affects a small internal workflow for model snapshots. We'll loop legal and infra, will have mitigation plan by Thu.

Avery (CEO): Metrics quick glance (week-over-week): MRR +4.1%, trial-to-paid conversion +9%, p99 latency generation 380ms (down 6%), average token cost -8% w/Optimize pilots. Revenue ops flagged two customers for Dedicated upsell; follow-up assigned to Sales.

Priya (Head of Customer Success): Dedicated upsell leads noted. I'll schedule intro calls with AMs.

Avery (CEO): Hiring pulse: opening 4 roles for data infra and 2 for SRE. Recruiting ramp is green; please accelerate interview panels. People ops, any blockers?

Mira (VP Product): Nothing from product side. We'll prioritize candidate funnels for product infra.

Avery (CEO): Final: small townhall Friday 10:30am PT  20m to cover incident learnings, Optimize roadmap, and policy changes. Q&A at the end. Please be on time.

deploy-bot: deploy 1822.3 to prod by @Jon  canary 15%  health checks ok.

Avery (CEO): Appreciate the quick turn this week. Let's keep focus on reliability and making the Optimize bet measurable. :sparkles:
